text: Heavy rain caused flooding in the town. The flooding blocked the main road. Emergency crews closed the road to prevent accidents.

revisions.text: Intense rainfall led to flooding in the town. The resulting flood blocked the main road. Emergency crews closed the road to avoid accidents.
Because of heavy rain, the town experienced flooding that made the main road inaccessible. To prevent accidents, emergency crews subsequently closed the road.
The main road was closed by emergency crews after flooding caused by heavy rain had blocked it. The closure was intended to prevent accidents.
Persistent rainfall produced severe flooding across the town, leaving the main route unusable. Authorities then shut the road as a precaution against accidents.

text: A power outage stopped the refrigeration system in the warehouse. The temperature inside increased. Several food products spoiled.

revisions.text: An electrical failure shut down the warehouse refrigeration system. The temperature subsequently rose, causing several food items to spoil.
Because the refrigeration system lost power, the warehouse became warmer, which resulted in several food products spoiling.
Several food products spoiled after the warehouse temperature increased when its refrigeration system stopped following a power failure.
The warehouse lost electricity, disabling its cooling equipment. Without refrigeration, the indoor temperature climbed and eventually damaged a number of stored foods.

text: The driver was distracted by a phone call. He failed to notice the red light. His car entered the intersection and collided with another vehicle.

revisions.text: The driver became distracted while talking on the phone. As a result, he missed the red signal, drove into the intersection, and crashed into another vehicle.
While distracted by a phone conversation, the driver failed to see the red light, causing him to enter the intersection where his car hit another vehicle.
Another vehicle was struck in the intersection after the driver, distracted by a phone call, overlooked the red light and continued driving.
A conversation on the driver's phone diverted his attention. He therefore missed the traffic signal, proceeded through the junction, and eventually crashed into another car.

text: The software update introduced a memory leak. The application consumed more memory over time. Eventually, the application crashed.

revisions.text: A new software update created a memory leak. The application gradually used more memory until it eventually crashed.
After the software was updated, a memory leak caused the application's memory usage to increase continuously, eventually resulting in a crash.
The application ultimately crashed because its memory consumption kept growing after the latest update introduced a memory leak.
Following the update, the program developed a resource-management problem. Its memory usage steadily accumulated until the system could no longer keep the application running.

text: The student forgot to submit the assignment before the deadline. The university recorded the submission as late. The student received a penalty.

revisions.text: The student missed the assignment deadline because he forgot to submit it. The university marked the work as late and imposed a penalty.
Because the student failed to remember the submission deadline, the assignment was submitted late, which led the university to apply a penalty.
A penalty was given after the university classified the assignment as late because the student had forgotten to submit it before the deadline.
The student overlooked the required submission date. Consequently, the university registered the assignment as overdue and applied a late-submission penalty.
